designNotes:
Created 2026-09-30 from this regular's cast entry in canon/scenes/rest--night-shift.json. Everything about who they are and what they want is that entry's own; only the physical description and the ancestry are new.

ANCESTRY, chosen by Claude under Ingram's 2026-09-30 goal (any ancestry is allowed): Elf ('For millennia, elves have dwelled among the stars and charted courses across the galaxy.' -- ancestry-catalogue.json): one of Golarion's own peoples, so no disguise is needed.

PORTRAIT: See the asset registry note for kaede: image 2: pencil poised over the clipboard, orange crew number on the sleeve. Character-portrait template, --ar 2:3, stylize 200, gouache and watercolour anime illustration on a flat teal-grey wall, warm orange golden-hour light across the face.

VOICE NOTES: forced catchphrases in this regular's tics and sample lines were rewritten as habits and manner (tools/art-review/ledger.json has each before and after).

Her or his real statblock is still a placeholder in the scene file (Proposed: level 3, a skilled working adult, non-combat. Made with Ingram once the NPC generator exists.); not carried here.
